intro: Bernice's Necklace is a sentimental heirloom belonging to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield of the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest. Originally worn as a lucky charm by her late husband during his military service, the trinket was lost near the Fargodeep Mine and snatched by an opportunistic kobold.

p: Though known locally as Bernice's necklace, the piece originally belonged to Auntie Bernice Stonefield's late husband. A veteran of Stormwind's military campaigns, he carried the charm as a token of good fortune into battle. According to Bernice, the only time tragedy struck was during his final campaign—the one expedition where he forgot to bring his lucky necklace along. Following his death, the keepsake remained one of Bernice's most cherished possessions on the Stonefield Farm.
